candidates.title: Riyadh Season: BLVD City
candidates.summary: Boulevard City is one of Riyadh Season’s most iconic entertainment hubs, offering a vibrant mix of attractions, from the dazzling dancing fountain to upscale dining, shopping, theaters, and immersive experiences for all ages. Visitors can explore OLULOU, where a towering dinosaur skeleton offers the perfect photo op, and let kids dive into four imaginative zones at PLAY-TOPIA. For thrill-seekers, Poppy Playtime delivers suspense inside an abandoned toy factory, A Lot Like Life challenges your bravery in a zombie outbreak, and The Conjuring opens October 15 with spine-chilling scenes from the haunted universe of Annabelle. Families can brave the haunted farm at Zeela House, while pop culture lovers enjoy FUNKO (from Nov 15), with giant figures and collectibles, and gamers embark on a real-world adventure inside MINECRAFT (also from Nov 15). Launching December 18, Flying Over Saudi offers a groundbreaking 5D flight experience that takes you on a 7-minute immersive ride above Saudi Arabia’s most iconic landmarks.

candidates.title: Horses and Equestrian Heritage Exhibition
candidates.venue: King Abdulaziz Public Library (Khurais Branch), Riyadh
candidates.summary: The King Abdulaziz Public Library is hosting a specialized exhibition on horses and equestrian heritage in celebration of Saudi Founding Day. The exhibition showcases a rich collection of manuscripts, rare books, photographs, historical documents, Islamic miniatures, and illustrated works highlighting the deep-rooted equestrian legacy of the Kingdom. Marking four decades of preserving cultural heritage, the library also presents selections from its dedicated Equestrian Center, which houses more than 12,000 rare Arabic and international references on horses, alongside historic photographs captured by Princess Alice of Britain during her 1938 visit to Saudi Arabia.

candidates.title: Solo Art Exhibition Series
candidates.venue: Prince Faisal Bin Fahd Arts Hall, Riyadh
candidates.summary: Misk Art Institute presents the third edition of the Solo Series, spotlighting established Saudi artists Fouad Mougharbel and Saad Almasari, whose work has contributed significantly to the Kingdom’s evolving visual culture. Through two individual exhibitions—“Taibah: Remnants and Solace” by Dr. Fouad Mougharbel and “Geometry as Thought” by Saad Almasari—the series offers insight into their artistic journeys and practices, reflecting their sustained engagement with the local art scene. Together, the exhibitions highlight diverse perspectives and approaches that contribute to shaping Saudi Arabia’s contemporary artistic identity. Alongside the exhibitions, a curated public program provides opportunities for deeper engagement: Exhibition Program: May 6: Artist Signing with Dr. Fouad Mougharbel & Saad Almasari | 7 PM May 7: Curator-Led Tour | 6 – 7 PM Artist Talk with Dr. Fouad Mougharbel | 8 – 8:45 PM Artist Talk with Saad Almasari | 9 – 9:45 PM May 9 Workshop: Exhibition Design | 7 – 9 PM May 9 – 11 Intensive Workshop: Pattern Design (Inspired by Saad Almasari) | 7 – 9 PM. candidates.rich_summary: Opening May 20, 2026, ‘Red Wind, Coral Worlds’ is an upcoming exhibition curated by recipients of the Art Jameel Curatorial Open Call, Huda Tayob and Miriam Hillawi Abraham. Red Wind, Coral Worlds sites the Red Sea within an expanded and interconnected oceanic terrain. Drawing on familial and communal archives, they speak to ongoing waves of disruption and continuity.

candidates.rich_summary: Opening May 20, 2026, ‘Global Positioning System’ is an upcoming exhibition curated by Indranjan Banerjee and Lucas Morin. Global Positioning System is an exhibition dedicated to mapping and navigation systems. It tells stories of fast cars and slow trains, street barriers and trembling grounds, warping highways and broken bridges. Gathering over forty artists across Art Jameel’s two centres in Jeddah and Dubai, the exhibition presents a wide range of artistic practices—from research-based engagements with infrastructure projects to conceptual works that question the very perception of distance. Maps, remaining the dominant representation space, carry a heavy weight. Far from reflecting geography objectively, they are instruments of power that embody specific worldviews. Though based on mapping, navigation systems like GPS render traditional maps redundant; they reduce navigation to an abstract exercise and remove the need to comprehend the physical space one moves through.

candidates.title: Art Futures Camp 2026 – Diriyah Art Futures
candidates.organizer: Diriyah Art Futures (DAF) | Ministry of Culture
candidates.summary: Art Futures Summer Camp for Arabic-Speaking Teens is a three-week immersive programme hosted by Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), the MENA region’s first centre dedicated to New Media Arts. Designed for Arabic-speaking teens aged 14–18, the camp offers an in-depth introduction to digital art practices in a dynamic and supportive environment. Under the 2026 theme, “Digital Art and Portraiture,” participants explore new ways of representing identity in the digital age, questioning how individuals are portrayed when faces become data and images circulate beyond physical presence. The programme combines creative experimentation with foundational technical skills, including Fab Lab practices and digital studio portraiture. Throughout the camp, participants work closely with industry specialists and creative mentors, culminating in a collaborative exhibition produced with DAF’s curatorial and exhibition teams to showcase their work. Applications are officially open, with aspiring young creatives in Riyadh able to apply until Sunday, June 7.

candidates.title: Registration for International Research Competition on Non-Terrestrial Networks

The competition invites researchers, graduate students, and recent PhD graduates from around the world to submit innovative research on non-terrestrial networks, future wireless communications, and the integration of terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. Selected finalists will present their research during the Global Space Connectivity and Sustainability Events in Riyadh, where the winners will be announced. The competition aims to promote research and innovation in next-generation connectivity technologies and strengthen international collaboration in developing sustainable communications solutions. candidates.summary: تطلق جامعة الجوف البرنامج الصيفي بجامعة الجوف 1447هـ – 2026م، بوصفه برنامجًا نوعيًا متكاملًا يستهدف تنمية المهارات وتطويرها، ونشر ثقافة الابتكار، وترسيخ ثقافة التطوع وخدمة المجتمع، بما يعزز دور الجامعة التنموي والمجتمعي، ويفتح مسارات واسعة لاستثمار فترة الصيف في برامج معرفية وتدريبية وتطوعية ورياضية موجهة لمنسوبي الجامعة وطلبتها والخريجين وأفراد المجتمع. ويستهدف البرنامج، الذي يمتد من شهر يوليو حتى نهاية أغسطس 2026م، أكثر من 16,000مستفيد من داخل الجامعة وخارجها، من خلال أكثر من 50 برنامجًا وفعالية نوعية، وما يزيد على 210 ساعة تدريبية مكثفة، إلى جانب مشاركة أكثر من 300 متطوع أكاديمي وطبي، وتنفيذ أكثر من 11,000 ساعة تطوعية معتمدة، إضافة إلى أكثر من 10 بطولات رياضية صيفية.

candidates.title: SAIF Summer Program
candidates.venue: SAMoCA (Saudi Arabia Museum of Contemporary Art), Jax District, Diriyah
candidates.summary: SAIF 2026 is a summer creative programme presented by SAMoCA, taking place from 12 July to 29 August 2026 in the JAX District, Diriyah. Designed to celebrate Saudi creativity and inspire emerging talent, the programme offers a vibrant series of artistic workshops, cultural experiences, and curated film screenings for children, teenagers, adults, and families. Held primarily on weekends, SAIF 2026 features hands-on workshops in ceramics, textile arts, papermaking, sound design, photography, storytelling, and other creative disciplines, alongside the "Little Moments" parent-and-child sessions and a curated cinema programme throughout August. Developed in collaboration with Art of Heritage, Knowliom, and Color Theory, the programme provides an inspiring environment for visitors to explore contemporary Saudi creativity, develop new skills, and engage with art and culture through interactive learning experiences. candidates.title: Tafasahu: Make Room
candidates.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
candidates.summary: Tafasahu: Make Room is an exhibition that showcases a commissioned installation by Saudi architect and artist, Nada AlMulla, which invites you to enter as a guest—to pause, gather and reflect on the conditions of belonging within the context of the traditional Majlis, Arabic for "gathering space." Beyond being a place to receive and host guests, the Majlis has been a vessel for the transmission of knowledge and heritage. The installation deconstructs this space into its essential elements while centering stories, memories and subtle traces of everyday life that animated it: conversations shared over coffee, the lingering scent of incense, the rhythms of gathering and departure. candidates.rich_summary: This intensive three-day course with artist and designer Pharah Al-Ghalib offers a comprehensive introduction to wheel-thrown pottery, guiding participants through the full spectrum of the ceramic process. Day 1 Clay & Wheel Fundamentals: Focuses on understanding clay—its qualities, preparation, and potential. Participants will learn wedging techniques before moving to the wheel to practice centering, opening, and pulling walls, creating several forms to be set aside to dry to a leather-hard stage. Day 2 Refinement & Practice: Focuses on refining technique through trimming leather-hard pieces on the wheel, shaping and finishing forms while improving both skill and confidence. Participants will also continue throwing practice, reinforcing foundational techniques and experimenting with new forms. Day 3 Surface Design & Glaze: Explores surface design on unfired clay.

candidates.title: Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo
candidates.summary: Taking place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Convention Center, Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo is the Kingdom’s first dedicated trade event for museums, heritage, and cultural development. The three-day exhibition brings together more than 100 exhibiting companies and over 3,000 visitors, including museums, galleries, science centers, cultural institutions, government entities, private collectors, and heritage developers. Co-located with the Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo (SEA Expo) and the Saudi Light and Sound Expo (SLS Expo), Merath provides a strategic platform to connect with decision-makers and explore opportunities within Saudi Arabia’s rapidly expanding $67 billion heritage and museum market, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a growing hub for cultural innovation and investment.

candidates.title: Saudi Light and Sound (SLS) Expo
candidates.summary: Discover the future of Saudi Arabia’s professional light and sound industry at the Saudi Light & Sound (SLS) Exhibition, the premier platform for event technology, lighting design, and audio innovations. The exhibition offers a rare opportunity to present AV and lighting solutions at the heart of a fast-evolving market, with the Pro AV segment valued at $30.5 million in 2024 and projected to reach $40.5 million by 2033, fueled by smart city investments and immersive event infrastructure. Visitors can connect with decision-makers driving billion-dollar projects, explore cutting-edge solutions across pro lighting, audio equipment, stage technology, digital signage, laser effects, and theatrical systems, and position their brand at the forefront of the region’s pro light and sound transformation. candidates.title: Saudi Falcons Club Auction
candidates.summary: The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.

candidates.title: Melwah Falcon Racing
candidates.venue: Saudi Falcons Club in Malham - Riyadh
candidates.summary: Melwah Racing 2026 takes place from October 4 to 9, bringing together falconers and enthusiasts for one of the Kingdom’s most anticipated falconry competitions. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the event celebrates a traditional sport deeply rooted in Saudi heritage while supporting the Kingdom’s position as a global hub for falconry. Held on an expansive field, the race tests the speed, agility, and training of competing falcons. Birds are released from the arms of their handlers and fly toward a lure operator positioned 200 meters away, with the fastest recorded times determining the winners across multiple categories. Featuring financial prizes and prestigious titles, Melwah Racing highlights the close bond between falconer and bird, while promoting public interest in this historic tradition.

candidates.title: World Stadiums and Arenas Summit
candidates.summary: The World Stadiums and Arenas Summit—the region’s largest stadiums and sports facilities conference and exhibition—returns to Riyadh at Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences. This flagship gathering brings together global leaders, architects, developers, government stakeholders, and sports federations to showcase cutting-edge technologies, sustainable design solutions, and best practices in building and upgrading stadiums and sports venues. With Saudi Vision 2030 driving major investment in sports and entertainment infrastructure, the summit offers a front-row view of the latest industry trends—from smart stadiums to eco-friendly facilities—and how they are shaping the future of sport in the Kingdom and beyond. Register Now World Sports 360 Summit | Athlete 360 Co-located with the World Stadiums and Arenas Summit, World Sports 360 Summit | Athlete 360, brings together global experts, elite athletes, coaches, and industry leaders to shape the future of sports, wellness, and human performance in the Kingdom. Focused on integrating performance and health, the programme spotlights cutting-edge performance optimisation (recovery, data-driven training, and advanced technology), holistic athlete development (nutrition, sports medicine, mental resilience, and long-term wellbeing), and the evolving Saudi sports landscape powered by Vision 2030. Expect practical insights, knowledge exchange, and forward-looking discussions spanning the sports economy, club management, revenue strategies, talent development and scouting, and the latest innovations in athlete technology and performance. Register Now The programme also features the World Stadiums and Arenas Awards , celebrating standout achievements in stadium and arena development across 10 categories highlighting innovation, sustainability, and exceptional project delivery—including architectural design for new venues, renovation and modernisation, innovative materials, multi-use design, creative lighting, eco-friendly architecture, community and social impact, safety and security leadership, accessibility and inclusivity initiatives, and the People’s Choice Award for outstanding stadium design.

candidates.title: AlUla Tour
candidates.organizer: Royal Commission for AlUla / Experience AlUla
candidates.summary: AlUla Tour is a major fixture on the international cycling calendar, attracting the world’s top teams and riders for a multi-stage race through one of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. From dramatic desert backdrops to iconic landmarks like Maraya and the Oasis, each stage delivers high performance and unforgettable scenery in equal measure. Individual AlUla Tour stages will be announced closer to the race date, but previous editions have seen riders traverse routes from Old Town to Harrat Uwayrid and Winter Park to Wirkah Mountain.

candidates.title: 24th ERRA Annual Conference
candidates.summary: The 24th ERRA Annual Conference takes place in Riyadh from February 1 to 3, bringing together international regulators, experts, and industry leaders to discuss the future of electricity sector governance and transformation. Hosted by the Saudi Electricity Regulatory Authority (SERA), the conference is held under the theme “From Oversight to Foresight: The Proactive Regulator in the Electricity Transformation.” The conference explores forward-looking regulatory approaches, innovation in electricity markets, consumer protection, and evolving energy systems. It also reflects Riyadh’s growing role as a destination for major international forums and supports the Kingdom’s wider ambitions in energy leadership and sustainable development. Registration

candidates.title: Human Capability Initiative Conference
candidates.venue: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh
candidates.summary: Under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince, Prime Minister, and Chairman of the Human Capability Development Program (HCDP) Committee, the third edition of the Human Capability Initiative (HCI) Conference—one of the Saudi Vision 2030 Realization Programs—will take place on April 12–13, 2027, at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh under the theme “The Human Code.” The conference will focus on three pillars: deep human connection, sound reasoning amid complexity, and value-driven creation to safeguard human contribution and purpose in the age of accelerated technological advancement. HCI 2027 aims to attract more than 15,000 visitors and over 250 local and international speakers, including policymakers, thought leaders, and experts from government, private, nonprofit, and global institutions, providing a platform to exchange best practices and showcase inspiring global success stories. The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland will participate as Country of Honor, reflecting the strength of the Saudi-British strategic partnership in advancing human capability development. Building on the success of previous editions—which welcomed over 23,000 visitors, featured 550+ speakers, and announced more than 156 launches and agreements—the conference reinforces the Kingdom’s commitment to investing in human potential as a foundation for sustainable growth and global competitiveness in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
